claim_scope: train-only Background-WFP architecture pilot with paired FNO control; not validation/test promotion
hypothesis: On a fixed group-disjoint four-family train panel, full-support local mixing between neighboring two-dimensional spatial Fourier modes will predict sigma-2 background pressure and exterior CPML states more accurately than a matched encoder/head using conventional truncated full-2D FNO blocks.
mechanism: Both arms share MIONet-style separate medium/source encoders, frequency FiLM, an exact physical-domain pressure head, a distinct 20-layer exterior-CPML auxiliary head and hard free/outer boundaries. Only the global propagation block changes: WFP uses compact full-support frequency-window convolution; control uses mode-32 full-2D FNO.

training.calibration: 32 fixed holdout records used for checkpoint selection
training.confirmation: 32 disjoint holdout records used once after checkpoint selection

primary_metric: two-seed mean confirmation physical 64-bin relative L2
failure_signal: Reject E1 and do not expand to 2800 if WFP mean confirmation physical error is not strictly below FNO, any family is missing, outputs are non-finite, boundary hard constraints fail, or split access/binding drifts.

conditional_next_steps.on_accept: build the same compact frequency/CPML cache for all 2800 train records, then run full-pool pretraining
conditional_next_steps.on_reject: retain artifacts, diagnose frequency/family/CPML errors and do not generate new synthetic training data
conditional_next_steps.targeted_new_data: only after an accepted full-pool model exposes stable HCAIS coverage gaps

rollback: All E1 files are additive. Preserve every existing A3, B2-H, Helmholtz, ASAM, CPADC and Transfer-DG checkpoint. Keep only best/latest for each new training lane. Do not expand the cache or generate synthetic samples after a rejected E1.
